intro.h2: More than glass: full bathrooms and kitchens since the 1990s
paragraphs: Specialty Kitchens and Baths, LLC handles bathroom remodeling in Warren, MI and across Oakland, Macomb and western Wayne County. Many homeowners know the company by its other name, Designs in Glass, because owner Howard Emmer built his reputation on frameless and euro glass shower doors.

The company does far more than glass. Howard's crews tear out and rebuild whole bathrooms and kitchens, then finish them with custom cabinets, granite or quartz counters, tile and lighting. Almost everything is custom built for your space, and you get one-on-one service from Howard from the first visit to the final install.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Warren, MI and the rooms around it

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Major and minor bathroom renovations, from a new shower to a full remodel down to the studs. Work covers custom bathroom design, vanities and cabinets, countertops, custom tubs, glass shower doors, tile and lighting, all built to fit your space.

image.alt: Wixom, MI bathroom remodel with a white modern vanity and quartz top, deep soaking tub with white tile surround and dark floor tile

items.name: Glass Shower Doors and Enclosures
items.blurb: The Designs in Glass specialty: frameless and seamless glass doors, euro shower doors, corner stalls, walk-in showers and sliding doors, with custom glass, metal and hardware choices. Howard can upgrade an existing shower or pair new glass with fresh tile.

image.alt: Novi, MI bathroom with a neo-angle frameless glass shower enclosure, beige tile walls with a decorative stripe and a corner jetted tub

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Complete kitchen renovations and makeovers, including kitchen design, cabinets, islands and bars, countertops, flooring, backsplash and lighting. Gallery projects include kitchens in Novi, Troy, Farmington Hills, Birmingham and Bloomfield.

image.alt: Novi, MI kitchen renovation with maple cabinets, a blue-gray quartz island, stainless built-in refrigerator and hardwood floors

items.name: Countertops and Custom Cabinets
items.blurb: Granite, quartz and butcher block counters for kitchens, baths, islands, bars and seating nooks, plus kitchen, bath and pantry cabinets, new doors and refinishing. Howard explains the trade-offs of each material before anything is cut or installed.

image.alt: South Lyon, MI kitchen with dark espresso cabinets, a long black granite island and stainless wall ovens

items.name: Tile, Flooring and Lighting
items.blurb: Ceramic and granite tile, wood flooring and custom backsplashes, plus recessed, track, ceiling and fixture lighting. These can finish a full remodel or stand alone as a quicker upgrade, and floors are covered by the same 2-year workmanship warranty.

image.alt: Birmingham, MI kitchen with white cabinets, an island with wire stools, three industrial pendant lights and recessed ceiling lights

items.title: You get Howard
items.text: Owner Howard Emmer gives one-on-one service on every project. Google reviewers mention Howard by name, saying he assessed the job, listened to what they asked for and was very accommodating on a tight timeline.

items.title: Glass specialists in the crew
items.text: Because the company also runs Designs in Glass, frameless shower doors and enclosures are done by people who install them all the time. Reviewers single out custom shower doors more than any other feature.

items.title: A 2-year workmanship warranty
items.text: Every remodeling and renovation project comes with a two-year workmanship warranty, so your new bathroom, kitchen or floor is covered well after installation day.

items.title: Decades of local referrals
items.text: Over 30 years in business with an A+ BBB rating. One reviewer's family hired the company for one project and came back for several more, and the owner says many referrals come from neighbors.

about.text: Howard Emmer owns Specialty Kitchens and Baths, LLC and Designs in Glass, and he has worked in kitchen and bathroom remodeling for over 30 years. He still meets each homeowner himself, looks through the space, and walks them through cabinet, countertop and glass choices before writing up a proposal. In his own words: "I love seeing my customers happy with the service we provide for them. Transforming parts of their home into beautifully remodeled areas is something that changes lives, and I am glad to be a part of that." Reviewers also mention Bob, who worked alongside Howard on a full bathroom gut renovation.

image.alt: Howard Emmer, owner of Specialty Kitchens and Baths, LLC and Designs in Glass

process.h2: How a project with Howard gets started

steps.title: Call or email for an appointment
steps.text: Visits are by appointment only. Call (248) 798-1000 or email to set a time for your free consultation.

steps.title: Free in-home consultation
steps.text: Howard looks through the space with you, talks through what you want, and explains the pros and cons of the cabinets, counters and glass you are considering.

steps.title: Written proposal
steps.text: After the visit, you receive a written proposal for the work, with custom pieces designed to fit your room.

steps.title: Build, install and warranty
steps.text: The crew completes the remodel and installs your custom glass, cabinets, counters and tile. The finished work is covered by a 2-year workmanship warranty.

service_area.h2: Serving Oakland, Macomb and western Wayne County
service_area.text: The office is in Warren, and visits are by appointment. The company's service-area page lists towns in three counties: Macomb (Warren, Sterling Heights, Clinton Township, Roseville, Centerline), Oakland (from Novi, Troy and Royal Oak to Birmingham, Bloomfield Hills and Rochester Hills) and Wayne (Northville and Plymouth). Gallery projects include Novi, Wixom, South Lyon, Royal Oak, Birmingham, Troy and Farmington Hills. If your town is not listed, ask anyway.

items.a: No. Many people assume so because of the Designs in Glass name, but Specialty Kitchens and Baths is a full-service remodeling company. Howard's team handles complete bathroom and kitchen remodels, basements, custom cabinets, granite and quartz countertops, floor tile and lighting, as well as glass shower doors.

Yes. Howard will meet with you for a free consultation and write up a proposal for your project. Visits are by appointment only, so call (248) 798-1000 or send an email to set a time. The office is open weekdays from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm and Saturdays from 10:00 am to 4:00 pm.

items.q: Can you just replace my shower door and update the shower?
items.a: Yes. You can upgrade an existing shower with a new frameless or euro glass door, or add new tile and fixtures at the same time. One Google reviewer had a real tile floor laid over the old one and worn glass replaced with high-quality glass that has a coating to help prevent water stains.

items.q: Should I choose granite or quartz counters?
items.a: Both can last well over 25 to 30 years. Granite is cut from a solid piece of stone, is more prone to chipping and needs to be sealed and resealed over time. Quartz is made from crushed quartz bound with resin and does not need sealing. Howard will walk you through both.

items.q: What warranty comes with the work?
items.a: All remodeling and renovation projects come with a two-year workmanship warranty, so your new bathroom, kitchen, floors or glass stay covered well after installation. The company is also BBB accredited with an A+ rating, and it has more than 30 years of remodeling experience in Metro Detroit.

final_cta.text: Call (248) 798-1000 or send a message to set up a free consultation and written proposal for your bathroom, kitchen or shower glass.
